<script>

    var ret = f.apply(this, arguments);
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('pushstate'));
    return ret;
  })(history.pushState);
</script>

      page_location: e.target.document.URL
    });
  }, false);
  function loadGtag() {
    var tag = document.createElement('script');
    tag.async = true;
    tag.src = 'https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=G-G6P1S31J8L';

    setTimeout(loadGtag, 0);

  }
</x-oasis-script>
